title: Space Shooter
prompt:
Build a vertical space shooter on a 480x640 field. The ship sits near the bottom, moves sideways (clamped) and fires bullets that fly up 6-12 units per tick and vanish off the top; firing has a cooldown of at most 15 ticks. Enemies arrive in seeded waves from the top and descend at least 1 unit per tick; while spawning is on, an empty field gets a new wave within 120 ticks. A bullet destroys an enemy (+10 or more). An enemy touching the ship is destroyed and costs a life; an enemy reaching the bottom also costs a life. 3 lives; 0 ends the game. After a hit the ship may be invulnerable for at most 120 ticks. Keyboard: arrows/A/D move, Space fires (hold to auto-fire). Touch: the ship follows the finger's x and auto-fires while touching.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, lives, wave, width:480, height:640, shipX, shipY, bullets:[{x,y}], enemies:[{x,y}]}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.press(name): hold 'left' or 'right'
- Game.input.release(name): release it
- Game.input.fire(): fire one bullet immediately unless cooling down
- Game.debug.setSpawning(on): turn automatic waves off or on
- Game.debug.clearEnemies(): remove all enemies
- Game.debug.spawnEnemy(x, y): add a basic enemy that moves straight down

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): movement, bullets and cooldown, kills, lives, game over, waves, seeded formations, keyboard and touch.
